results.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) | Charles River Associates
results.content: CRA experts employ their technical expertise in AI and forensic methodologies to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and depth of forensic investigations, leveraging advanced technologies to uncover comprehensive insights from complex digital environments while adhering to legal and ethical standards. CRA’s Investigations & Compliance experts assess the potential risks and challenges posed by AI systems, identifying potential vulnerabilities, and conducting adversarial testing, facilitating that AI systems are implemented, maintained, and audited in a matter to comply with ethical, legal, and industry standards. Consultants assist in developing robust governance frameworks and policies for using AI technologies, establishing protocols for monitoring and auditing their systems, assessing data quality and versioning controls, evaluating compliance with data protection regulations, providing training on recognizing AI bias, and implementing strategies to mitigate the associated risks. CRA’s Labor and Employment professionals possess extensive experience evaluating adverse impact claims and responding to regulatory and litigation concerns for clients in numerous industries and jurisdictions, giving them extensive expertise to advise firms in adopting and evaluating AI tools.

results.title: Bloch Executive Series Archives - University of Missouri-Kansas City
results.content: University of Missouri - Kansas City. This highly engaging session provides leaders with the frameworks and hands-on experience needed to address today’s complex and unpredictable business challenges. Through a combination of applied exercises and reflective learning, leaders build the adaptability and resilience needed to thrive. Leaders operate in a time of constant flux, facing ambiguous challenges, technological disruption, and the need for organizational agility. Adaptive leadership is a vital skill set for navigating these realities, empowering leaders to mobilize teams, confront the unknown, and drive innovation through uncertainty. This workshop is ideal for leaders at all levels who face the challenges of guiding their teams and organizations through uncertain times and complex problems. Whether you are leading a small team or an entire organization, this session will equip you with the understanding and tools to embrace change, face challenges head-on, and emerge stronger. The focus of this workshop is on managing for value.

results.title: 2025 Planning, Budgeting, and Analytics Forum - NACUBO
results.content: NACUBO’s 2025 Planning, Budgeting, and Analytics Forum offers strategies for higher education goal setting and resource management. In this demo session, you will learn how to identify actionable opportunities to improve the short- and long-term financial sustainability of your institution and its programs while keeping student success front and center. Discover how your institution can integrate data into its planning, budgeting, and capital strategies and position itself for long-term financial sustainability and improved student outcomes. This session will highlight Michigan State University’s newly launched budget and financial planning infrastructure using the Anaplan system. This session will showcase how the NACUBO Student Success Hub is helping two-year institutions—and others—integrate program cost analysis with student and labor market data to drive better planning, budgeting, and resource allocation decisions. This meeting is your opportunity to reach chief financial officers, vice presidents of finance, administration or budget, controllers, planning officers, budget directors, and other staﬀ within college and university finance services who focus on institutional planning, resource management, and goal setting.
